name: turborepo-saas-starter
description: Full-stack SaaS starter template — Turborepo monorepo with Next.js 16, Fastify REST API, Prisma, Better Auth, Socket.io, BullMQ, and shadcn/ui.

scripts.clean: rm -rf node_modules .turbo .next out dist build coverage .vercel && find . -name 'node_modules' -type d -prune -exec rm -rf {} + && find . -name '.turbo' -type d -prune -exec rm -rf {} + && find . -name '.next' -type d -prune -exec rm -rf {} + && find . -name 'dist' -type d -prune -exec rm -rf {} + && find . -name 'generated' -type d -prune -exec rm -rf {} + && find . -name 'tsconfig.tsbuildinfo' -type f -delete
